title: The Two Great Commandments as the Hinge of All Scripture
english: After the commandments to love God and neighbor, the question arises how the whole law and the prophets hang on these two commandments (Matthew 22:40). Whoever has fulfilled the love of God and neighbor is worthy of wisdom and the word of knowledge through the Spirit (1 Corinthians 12:8), and exults in the wisdom of God.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
orientation: Origen is opening his treatment of the two great commandments, explaining how the whole law and prophets hang on love of God and neighbor.

title: Christ's self-knowledge and the Pharisees' ignorance
english: The Savior knew himself to be made from the seed of David according to the flesh, predestined Son of God in power (Romans 1:3-4); he knew himself as “I am the way, and the truth, and the life” (John 14:6), as “before Abraham was, I am” (John 8:58), as the Word who was in the beginning with God (John 1:1). The Pharisees knew that according to the human dispensation he was from the seed of David, but they did not know the deeper things. Glory to Christ. Amen.

added_allusions.reason: seed of David / Son in power

translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
orientation: Origen is explaining what Jesus knew about himself as Son of David according to the flesh and Son of God in power, in contrast to what the Pharisees knew.
